## Changes
- **Container web pages always open in a new browser tab.** The 🌐 button in the Docker section no longer opens the app in a window over ArrHub – it is now a plain link to the best address (an https domain from Nginx Proxy Manager or the service's settings first). When a container has more than one address, a small ▾ next to it lists the others, each opening in a new tab. The embedded window, its "can this page be shown inside ArrHub" check and the `/api/docker/containers/:id/web` endpoint are gone.

## Fixes
- **Container action buttons no longer spill out of the row on narrower windows.** The row layout used to switch only by the browser window's width, so between roughly 1100 and 1200 px (with the side menu taking its share) the web, terminal, logs, restart, stop and update buttons ran past the right edge of the row. The rows now adapt to the width of the container list itself, and the buttons wrap instead of overflowing.
